run_librispeech_data_prep: run the script to download LibriSpeech data and extract fbank features for all splits
create_fbank_features: create log mel filter bank features from LibriSpeech audio waveforms and save as numpy files
generate_tsv_manifest: generate TSV manifest files with audio paths, frame counts, text, and speaker IDs for each split
build_vocab_model: build a SentencePiece vocabulary model from LibriSpeech training text using bpe, unigram, or char encoding
generate_config_yaml: generate a config YAML file with the vocab model path and specaugment policy for speech-to-text training
